description: This file defines the ProductsController class, which handles administrative operations related to products in a web application. It manages displaying product listings, pagination, product deletion, and menu setup, utilizing Spring MVC annotations and services for product and category management.

classes.name: ProductsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing product administration functionalities such as listing, paging, and deleting products.

methods.name: displayProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the main product management page, loads categories, and sets up the menu.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Handles POST requests for paginated fetching of products based on filters like category, SKU, availability, etc., returning JSON data.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a product by ID, with authorization and error handling.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the active menu items for the admin interface.
